issues.detail: The Greek 'αλλος δε εποικοδομει' (but another builds) is rendered as 'còn người khác thì xây lên trên' (but others build on top). The Vietnamese adds 'lên trên' (on top/upon), which is not explicitly in the Greek text, though it is implied by the context of 'foundation'.

The Greek 'εκαστος δε βλεπετω' (but let each [one] see) is rendered as 'nhưng mỗi người phải coi chừng' (but each person must watch out/be careful). While 'coi chừng' captures the warning, it slightly shifts the nuance from 'see/observe' to 'be careful/watch out'.
